question: Should this PR be landed as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99270 despite the session-state-sensitive classifier changes and the unrelated-looking QA Smoke failure on the exact head?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it changes shared-client and compaction-binding cleanup semantics, and automation should not decide whether the proof breadth plus current red QA gate are acceptable for merge.

options.title: Land current PR after gate handling
options.body: Treat this branch as the canonical fix once required checks are green or the QA Smoke failure is explicitly accepted as shared noise.

options.title: Request broader live startup proof
options.body: Ask for an additional live Codex app-server run that exercises startup fallback or shared-client cleanup before merge.

options.title: Prefer the competing candidate
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers decide https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99349 should be repaired and used instead.

recommendation.title: Land current PR after gate handling
